description: Latest public posts of one Telegram channel as shown on its public web preview (t.me/s/<channel>): post id, text, view count text and date, about 20 per page. Only public channels with a preview; the Telegram homepage itself has no data, so this tool reads a channel's public feed. Related tools on this server, for a different need: social_telegram_channel when you need Public Telegram channel from its t.me/s preview page; social_telegram_keyword_search when you need keyword search inside one public Telegram channel, using. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

channel.description: Public channel username without @ (5-32 letters, digits or _)
